title: Origins Final Tier List (Before Spiritforged)
author: Den
meta_overview: Kai'Sa dominated Origins in China with a refined list. Annie rose in North America as an aggressive scoring machine, becoming the only real rival. Miss Fortune finally won a major event late in the set. Sett declined due to Annie's rise. Only 16 legends in the Origins pool.
key_observations: Kai'Sa best legend of Origins globally — won Chinese National + multiple western events
Annie discovered late by NA community — different aggressive scoring build vs Chinese midrange approach
Annie won Houston Regional (4 in top 8, 3 in top 4)
Miss Fortune won Orlando Pro-Play Games Summit 10K — her first big win, came too late in set
Master Yi played OGN-160 in Game 1 then sided it out — adaptation strategy
Sett declined due to Annie sending units back to base, making showdowns impossible
Only 16 legends available in Origins set
Gap in power level most obvious in large events (hundreds of players)
